paras: Sundevall's worm snake (Tricheilostoma sundewalli) is a species of snake in the family Leptotyphlopidae. The species is endemic to Central Africa and West Africa.
The epithet, sundewalli, is in honor of Carl Jakob Sundevall, a Swedish zoologist.
T. sundewalli is found in Cameroon, Central African Republic, Ghana, Nigeria, and Togo.
